overview_description.description: Clozer is a digital marketing and creator-focused platform that enables users—especially musicians, artists, and online creators—to build a customised “link-in-bio” website that aggregates their online presence into a single page. The platform allows users to quickly create a personalised mini-site where they can share music, videos, social media links, merchandise, and event tickets with their audience.
